sk.title: Požičovňa áut Rýchlik
brief: Požičovňa áut Rýchlik v Žiline prenajíma autá a chce malý konzolový program pre svoju kanceláriu. Každé auto má evidenčné číslo (ŠPZ) a model. Každý zákazník má meno a telefónne číslo a kancelária musí vedieť, ktorý zákazník má ktoré auto.
Nové auto sa pridá príkazom `addcar`, za ktorým nasleduje ŠPZ a model. Program odpovie `Car BA123AB added.`

Auto sa prenajme príkazom `rent`, za ktorým nasleduje ŠPZ, meno zákazníka a jeho telefónne číslo. Ak je auto voľné, program odpovie `Car BA123AB rented to Peter.` Ak je už prenajaté, odpovie `Car BA123AB is already rented.` Ak auto s takou ŠPZ neexistuje, odpovie `Car XX999XX does not exist.`

Príkaz `customer`, za ktorým nasleduje meno, vypíše každé auto prenajaté zákazníkovi s týmto menom na samostatný riadok, napríklad `BA123AB Skoda`, v poradí, v akom boli autá pridané. Ak zákazník nemá žiadne auto, vypíše `Peter has no cars.` (s menom, na ktoré sa pýtame).

Program číta jeden príkaz na riadok a skončí príkazom `exit`. Každá hodnota v príkaze je jedno slovo. Okrem uvedených odpovedí program nevypisuje nič – žiadne menu, uvítanie ani výzvy na zadanie. Odpovede píš presne tak, ako sú uvedené (po anglicky).

en.title: Rychlik Car Rental
brief: Rychlik Car Rental in Žilina rents out cars and wants a small console program for its office. Every car has a licence plate and a model. Every customer has a name and a phone number, and the office must know which customer has which car.
A new car is added with the command `addcar`, followed by the plate and the model. The program replies `Car BA123AB added.`

A car is rented with `rent`, followed by the plate, the customer's name and phone number. If the car is available, the program replies `Car BA123AB rented to Peter.` If it is already rented, it replies `Car BA123AB is already rented.` If there is no car with that plate, it replies `Car XX999XX does not exist.`

The command `customer`, followed by a name, lists every car rented to a customer with that name on its own line, like `BA123AB Skoda`, in the order the cars were added. If that customer has no car, it prints `Peter has no cars.` (with the name that was asked for).

The program reads one command per line and ends with the command `exit`. Every value in a command is a single word. Apart from the replies above, the program prints nothing – no menu, no welcome text, no prompts.

design.link: Car.Customer → Customer (one-way: the car knows who rents it)

scenarios.en: Renting a free car assigns the customer
Renting a car that is already rented fails
The list of a customer's cars is exact
Renting a car that does not exist fails
